body.name: Candidate stopped diffusion system
body.construction: Before \(H=\inf\{t\ge0:\|D_t\|^2\le a\}\), \(dD_t=(-4D_t-8\gamma D_t/\|D_t\|^2)dt+\sqrt8\,dB_t\) and \(dE_t=-4E_tdt+\sqrt8\,dB'_t\), with \(D_0=G\), \(E_0=\varepsilon\), and \(G,\varepsilon,B,B'\) mutually independent; absorb both coordinates at \(H\).
